cuts.regime_of_a_day: the regime of its target day

reading.choice_marked_for_eleonora: the floor of 0.5 bp and the sign rule are the author's choice, marked in the pull request
reading.consequence_if_regime_coded: the pull request names the relative encodings (tbill - iorb, sofr_p75 - sofr and sofr - sofr_p25 in bp, volume over its trailing 60-row median, reserves as the as-of ratio) as the next declared variant
reading.consequence_if_stable: the pull request says the dependence is stable across regimes and the encoding avenue is dead
reading.regime_coded_dependence: for each of the five inputs, in each regime: the median's partial dependence 'reads' the input when it moves by at least 0.5 bp across the five points; its sign is that of the move from the first to the last point; the dependence is regime-coded when the regimes that read it do not all share one sign
reading.reserves_split: for reserve_balances, whether the median's dependence moves only across the segments between points that start at or below 1700 ($ bn) and is flat (under the floor) across the later segments, in each regime (the directive's example)

rulings: Eleonora, 19 October 2026 (relayed on #958): the five-lens review, Lens D; directive #964

partial_dependence.points: the 10, 30, 50, 70, 90th percentiles of the input over the panel's rows up to 2025-12-31 (computed by `declare`, in the panel's units: $ bn for reserve_balances, tga; percent for tbill_4w; the volume's own unit; bp for spread_bps)

statistics.permutation_importance: per refit block, per design column: the column's values are shuffled among the block's scored days (5 shuffles, random.Random of '964/<lead>/<block's first target day>/<input>/<repeat>'); importance = mean grid CRPS of the shuffled forecasts less the grid CRPS of the forecast, each against its own day's outcome; blocks shorter than 5 days are not shuffled
statistics.shock: q50 and q95 with each of the five inputs moved by plus and minus one standard deviation of the input over the block's training frame (as-of), the others as read
